ling: Canaryed aurelia-v1 int8 overnight. Quick aggregate shows JA/ZH generation BLEU regressed ~3.8 vs fp16 on news-multilang. Also a small subset of Arabic samples show bracket reversal when Latin is inside parens — looks like detok bidi ordering issue. anyone on?

arun: Oof. can you paste one or two failing snippets + eval command? pinging @mira for tokenizer trace.

ling: Sure. short repros below. Repro command: `./eval_run --model aurelia-v1 --quant int8 --dataset news-multilang --langs ja,zh,ar --samples 2k --seed 7`

JA input:
```
日本の（経済）報道は最新のデータを示しています。
```
int8 output (detok):
```
日本の（経済）報道は、最新のデータを示しています。
```
Note the extra halfwidth comma before the final clause and the tokenizer splitting before the closing fullwidth paren on int8.

Arabic input:
```
تقرير عن (السوق المحلي) والنمو المتوقع.
```
int8 output (detok):
```
تقرير عن )السوق المحلي( والنمو المتوقع.
```
brackets visually swapped.

mira: grabbed token-id dumps for both. For JA: int8 run has an extra subtoken id (token 1378) inserted right before U+FF09. For AR: punctuation gets emitted as separate tokens and the detok bidi step then places them in visual order incorrectly because of token separation.

arun: any changes to tokenizer or vocab in this bringup?

ling: None. Build manifest identical to baseline; quant pipeline changed qconfig and fused kernels.

qa-bot: Canary health: deploy success 2026-04-11T09:12:42Z. Perf: 1.05x throughput, 95th latency within target. Regression alert triggered: BLEU drop threshold exceeded for ja/zh.

mira: I computed embedding-centroid deltas for punctuation tokens (U+FF08 U+FF09 U+3001). Cosine similarity int8 vs fp16 down ~0.11 for U+FF09 and ~0.08 for U+3001. small but seems correlated with topk shifts at generation time.

arun: sounds like quant noise pushing a different subtoken into top-k around boundary, causing split. For Arabic bracket flip, detok's bidi logic expects punctuation tethered to surrounding letter tokens; when punctuation is emitted as standalone token, visual reordering happens differently.

ling: Proposed next steps: 1) run token-id diff across all failing JA/AR samples and collect the ones with punctuation splits 2) bisect quant kernel/fusion changes (start with PR #643 which reordered fused softmax) 3) add detok invariant test: if input contains mirrored punctuation pairs, detok output must preserve logical order (not flip) 4) try a quick re-run with unfused softmax to confirm.

arun: i'll start a bisect on the quant kernels now, focusing on fused-softmax and argmax changes.

mira: i'll prepare token-diff artifact and add ~200 failing examples to forensic store, plus a tiny notebook to reproduce extracts. uploading link when ready.

deploy-bot: Created issue: ML-501 (aurelia-int8 punctuation/topk regression). Assigned to @mira @arun.

arun: bisect update: first-bad is commit f1d2b9 (fused-softmax reorder + argmax micro-optim). Re-running with fusion off returns BLEU delta to within 0.2 for JA/ZH and fixes bracket flip for the Arabic example.

mira: confirmed locally: running `--quant=int8 --disable-fusion` keeps token-ids aligned with fp16 for those punctuation cases. I'll draft a hotfix to disable the specific fusion until we can adjust quant scaling.

ling: Can we do a targeted mitigation: avoid fused-softmax for batches containing punctuation-heavy tokens (whitelist by codepoints)? Might be lower perf impact than globally disabling fusion.

arun: that's possible; kernel can check a small bitmap per batch. but complexity to implement and test. short-term: temp-hotfix disable fusion for int8-only on production images. Long-term: adjust softmax scaling and re-evaluate precision.

qa-bot: Action items created: ML-502 (hotfix disable fusion for int8), ML-503 (detok mirrored-punct test), ML-504 (forensic ingest aurelia-punct-set).

mira: PR opened: hotfix/disable-int8-fused-softmax (PR #1320). CI running unit + smoke. Also added detok test under smoke-quant matrix.

ling: rolling canary back to previous image for traffic > 0.25 while PR runs. will monitor. thanks team :thumbsup:

arun: follow-up: i'll instrument softmax output logits for punctuation positions to capture whether quant rounding is shifting argmax. will attach traces to ML-503.

mira: uploaded artifacts: https://forensic.internal/ML-504/artifacts/aurelia-punct-samples and a small notebook.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed at 2026-04-11T09:48:02Z.

ling: keeping thread open until PR merges and smoke passes. good catch everyone.
